verses.12:92: قَالَ لَا تَثۡرِيبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ يَغۡفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

meaning: The root ثرب (thrb) primarily refers to removing fat from a ruminant's stomach. Tropically, it means to blame, reprove, or chastise severely, even to the point of rending reputations.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
